actions.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Affects children under 14, parents, consumers, and manufacturers or developers of AI-enabled toys.
dimensions.evidence: risk of injury... to children in different stages of development from AI-enabled toys

dimensions.assessment: Mandates studies and recommendations for potential future actions rather than directly enacting bans or new rules on toys.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a study regarding AI-enabled toys that assesses... recommendations regarding legislation or administrative action

dimensions.assessment: Directs federal entities and the National Academies to perform studies and action plans without specifying appropriations amounts.
dimensions.evidence: The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine shall conduct a study

dimensions.assessment: Initiates formal evaluation procedures, consumer education initiatives, and policy recommendations involving multiple federal bodies.
dimensions.evidence: Federal Trade Commission and the Consumer Product Safety Commission shall submit... a joint action plan

dimensions.assessment: Establishes temporary requirements for a study and a joint action plan due within two years of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: Authorized funding amounts to cover the cost of the National Academies study.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires a study on AI-enabled toys by the National Academies and a subsequent joint action plan by the FTC and CPSC, focusing on child safety and potential regulatory recommendations.
